text:
alex: Heads up — Meridian Logistics private rollout planned. Proposed start Thu 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC but we have a potential DB patch conflict. Requesting final approval for change window, pinned version, and rollback policy.

rachel: Security review done. KMS rotation ✅. No compliance blockers. I can be on-call for the window.

sandeep: Infra notes: need dedicated slice `gpu-pool-d-11` reserved and KV cache prewarm 15m prior. Validating model artifact; plan to pin to `redwood/llama-2-13b-q4f:v2.3.1`.

kevin: What's our rollback threshold? For previous rollouts we used error_rate>3% over 5m or sustained p95 spikes. I'll own rollback if we agree on the thresholds and runbook.

alex: Proposed rollout plan (canary -> ramp):
```
canary_percent: 10
canary_duration: 10m
ramp_steps: [25, 50, 100]
ramp_step_duration: 5m
pinned_model: redwood/llama-2-13b-q4f:v2.3.1
fallback_model: redwood/llama-2-13b-q4f:v2.2.8
alerts: error_rate>3% in 5m OR p50>800ms OR p95>1500ms
```
If any alert trips during canary -> immediate rollback to fallback_model.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @alex: 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Canary launch at +0m, ramp to 100% over ~20m. Reserved slice `gpu-pool-d-11` tentatively allocated.

ops-bot: Auto-alerts will be created: `meridian-rollout-errors` and `meridian-rollout-latency`. On-call rota: @rachel for first 2 hours, then @sandeep.

sandeep: One conflict: DB patch is scheduled 02:30-03:00 UTC which could overlap if we need extended rollback or hotfix. Suggest shifting earlier by 30m to avoid overlap.

alex: Good catch. Proposed new start 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC (canary at 01:00, ramp finish ~01:25). Preflight runbook at 00:30. Any objections?

rachel: 01:00 works for security and infra. I'll run the preflight cert and secret checks at -30m.

kevin: I'll own rollback. Rollback command + quick playbook snippet:
```
# rollback to fallback
redwoodctl rollout set --customer meridian --model redwood/llama-2-13b-q4f:v2.2.8 --force
# verify
redwoodctl status --customer meridian | grep model
```
Also: collect logs before action `rlog collect meridian --since 10m`.

alex: Finalizing: window moved to 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC. Preflight 2026-04-02 00:30 UTC. Pin v2.3.1, fallback v2.2.8. Rollback thresholds: error_rate>3% (5m) OR p95>1500ms. I'll post release notes and the cutover checklist in #docs and attach the runbook. :thumbsup:

kevin: Acknowledged — will be standing by. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: preflight runbook at 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z and rollout at 2026-04-02T01:00:00Z.
